{{Youmay|the plant|the Humans [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo Naberrie]] or [[Ryoo Thule]]}}
The '''ryoo''' was a beautiful blue and yellow [[Flower/Legends|flower]] that grew in the outlying hills near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Ryoo Thule]] and her great-granddaughter, [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo Naberrie]], were named after this flower.
